projects.name: jonnyhaynes-web
projects.description: My personal website — a static site built with React, Vite & TypeScript.
projects.pitch: My personal portfolio — a React + Vite SPA with live GitHub and Spotify data, a Modern Yorkshire theme, and an interactive topographic background.
projects.challenge: Keeping API secrets server-side while the site stays fully static: data is baked to JSON by scheduled GitHub Actions, with one Vercel function for live Spotify now-playing, so nothing sensitive ever reaches the client bundle.

projects.name: app-live
projects.description: Build an Expo app locally with EAS and install it on the device you ask for — a connected device or a BrowserStack App Live cloud device. Ships as both an MCP server and a CLI.
projects.pitch: Builds an Expo app locally with EAS and installs it onto whichever device you name — physical or BrowserStack cloud. Ships as an MCP server and a CLI.
projects.challenge: Making device routing invisible: one call detects whether the named device is local and picks the right installer, or falls back to BrowserStack — the caller never knows where the device lives.

projects.name: cmux-sentinel
projects.description: Opinionated cmux custom sidebar with live agent states and pluggable AI usage meters
projects.pitch: cmux-sentinel is an opinionated custom sidebar for cmux: a monospace workspaces list with live per-agent states and pluggable AI usage meters.
projects.challenge: cmux sidebars are sandboxed to a fixed set of fields, so agent state is smuggled through reference-counted title markers and usage meters are fed by background pollers.

projects.challenge: Computing honest ride distance and elevation from raw GPX.

projects.name: skillswap
projects.description: A community skill-swapping platform that connects neighbours to exchange knowledge and services — offer skills, propose swaps, and chat in real time.

lastCommit.message: fix(build): install Chromium system libs so prerendering works on Ver…

projects.pitch: A community skill-swapping platform — neighbours offer, request and swap skills, with real-time messaging and reviews.
projects.challenge: Auditing every Supabase RLS policy to close a profile-PII leak, without breaking cross-user features like messaging and the verified-neighbour badge.

projects.name: rovrum.town
projects.description: The place for everything Rotherham — news, sports, events & jobs, aggregated in one place. Alpha.
projects.pitch: Rovrum — a content platform aggregating Rotherham news, sports, events and jobs into one feed. An Astro front end over a Dockerised Node pipeline with PostgreSQL/Prisma.
projects.challenge: Collapsing the same story covered by different outlets — different URLs, differently-worded headlines — into one entry without wrongly merging distinct stories.

projects.name: colouringcode-web
projects.description: Single-page Next.js marketing site for Colouring Code, deployed on Vercel.
projects.pitch: The Colouring Code website — a single-page Next.js marketing site, styled with Tailwind and deployed on Vercel.
projects.challenge: Keeping a striking, type-led landing page fast and fully static with zero runtime dependencies.
